sources.label: Nov 12, Inman Tech Roundup + Real Estate News (two Tier 1 sources, corroborated)

stories.summary: Zillow Preview listings are homes not yet live on the shared listing database agents use. They now show inside RealScout, the home-search tool used by 100,000+ agents, after a September announcement. Preview listings, including coming-soons, now show in searches and alerts from hundreds of brokerages, and agents don't need to opt in. Once that period ends, it shows as a regular active listing.
stories.title: Zillow Preview listings go live in RealScout — pre-MLS inventory leaves Zillow's walls

stories.summary: Equity Angels announced its third cohort — the first built around getting agents to use a tool, not building one. Four founders get six weeks to build a sales plan, then pitch Dec 1; two are agent tools. Wispr (Tom Gabriele) is a market for pre-market listings across brokerages, and Sayso (Kuvaal Patel) listens to sales calls and prompts what to say next. Wispr says 25% of pre-market chances turned into signed deals — its own number, not checked.
stories.title: Equity Angels' go-to-market cohort bets on the pre-market shelf and the live call

stories.summary: Lofty launched a monthly index tracking how much time its AI tools save agents — the first vendor to publish a number and a method. In October, its tools did 1.13 million tasks and saved agents 131,248 hours, by Lofty's own math on how long each task takes. Solo agents saved 30% of their daily planning hours, and 387,824 leads got an AI follow-up. The release doesn't say how many agents that covers, and Lofty is Inman's official AI partner.
stories.title: Lofty publishes an AI time-saved index — the first vendor to put a number on the claim

stories.summary: Rechat launched Rechat Text in beta: it syncs an agent's one-to-one texts and calls into the lead system, so the agent can reply from the client's profile. Group chats, attachments, and emojis aren't supported yet. The logged chats can also be reached by Claude or ChatGPT through Rechat's plug that lets an AI tool pull data. CEO Shayan Hamidi says its AI, Lucy, now has the full context of those talks — the vendor's own claim.
stories.title: Rechat Text syncs every client text and call into the lead system — and into the AI's memory

hook: The private-listing fight just became a distribution fight.
market_map: Today's stories: Zillow's early listings go live in RealScout; a new cohort bets on the pre-market shelf and the live call. Lofty puts a number on AI time saved, and Rechat puts every text and call into the lead system.
one_line: The pre-market shelf — one agent-side view of every pre-market listing, with the cooperation status attached.

openings.text: Two findings point at the same gap from opposite sides. Zillow's pre-market listings now flow into RealScout, while Wispr builds a pre-market market across brokerages. Neither is owned by agents, neither covers every source, and neither answers the buyer's question: which pre-market homes can my buyer see, and on what terms? The listing-rights ledger from #25–#27 is the rule-following half, and the shelf is the search half — watch Wispr's Dec 1 Demo Day.
openings.title: The pre-market shelf — one agent-side view of every pre-market listing, with the cooperation status attached

watch.text: No new movement: a Nov 10 piece recaps the Nov 6 filing, where the judge wants proof the seller settlements are a yardstick for the buyer deals. Final approval is still undecided — do not cite approval. The fund is $120.3M, with 132,000+ claims, 25 opt-outs, and 2 objections; claims closed Oct 27.
watch.title: Tuccori buyer settlement — STILL no outcome, 10 days post-hearing.

watch.text: Compass now requires its agents to share listing info with outside firms, unless a client says otherwise in writing. The rule follows Bright MLS's rule for listings marketed off the shared listing database. The same week, Compass barred its W-2 staff from volunteer leadership at the national Realtor group.
watch.title: Compass makes broker-to-broker cooperation rules official (Nov 11, Real Estate News).

watch.text: Fewer than 3% of agents asked — only 4 of 105 at Compass firms — said each firm should decide if an agent's sales data goes to hiring tools. 16% of Compass agents want a full ban on listing systems sharing data with hiring tools, vs 7% elsewhere. Only 19% back things as they are, vs 36% elsewhere — agents want the choice themselves, not their firm.
watch.title: Compass recruiting-data fight — agents want control, but not brokerage control (Nov 9, Inman survey).

watch.text: A procedural step: Zillow responded to the amended complaint. The reconsideration denial from #27 stands — the Dupuis case's Preferred/Flex tying claim proceeds in Seattle.
watch.title: Zillow steering case — Zillow responded to the amended complaint (Nov 10, Real Estate News).

watch.text: Approved Nov 8: a local listing system may claim up to a 50% shared copyright interest in listing content, and set its own data-feed rules. No listing system has adopted it yet — watch for the first one.
watch.title: Copyright + data-feed policy — no adopter yet.

watch.text: Photo disclosure rules take effect Jan 1, 2027 in California and Wisconsin. North Texas fines agents from Feb 1, 2027 who don't show the original with AI-changed photos. In Ontario, the agent must say when AI shaped a listing — and answer for its accuracy.
watch.title: AI photo disclosure — hard deadline Jan 1, 2027 (50 days).
